q1.question: What can J.A.R.V.I.S. actually do for me?
q1.answer: It's a multi-agent AI assistant: semantic RAG document search, automatic AI model routing, and 30+ tool skills (reading files, running code, calling APIs...) — all through one natural conversation.

q2.question: Which AI models does it use, and how are they chosen?
q2.answer: The agent automatically routes between DeepSeek, Gemini, and Claude based on request complexity and cost — you never have to pick a model yourself.

q3.question: Is my uploaded data safe?
q3.answer: Yes. RAG data and documents are isolated per account (multi-tenant) and never shared across other users.

q4.question: What languages are supported?
q4.answer: Vietnamese and English — both the interface and the agent's replies follow whichever language you've selected.

q5.question: How do I get started?
q5.answer: Just sign up — no installation required. You can start chatting with the agent right after verifying your email.

faq.title: Quick answers before you sign up

q1.question: Does J.A.R.V.I.S. cost anything?
q1.answer: J.A.R.V.I.S. is currently in early access with no fixed pricing yet. Sign up now for priority access and to be the first to know when official pricing is announced.

q2.question: What's the difference between the Individual and Team plans?
q2.answer: Both plans share the same core features — RAG, multi-agent routing, tool skills, and contextual memory. The Team plan adds hands-on onboarding support when rolling out to an organization.

q3.question: Can I try it before committing to anything?
q3.answer: Yes. Sign up for early access to start chatting with the agent right away — no payment information required.

q4.question: Is my document data shared with other accounts?
q4.answer: No. RAG data and documents are isolated per account (multi-tenant), for both the Individual and Team plans.

featuresPage.pageDescription: Explore J.A.R.V.I.S.'s feature pillars in detail: Hybrid RAG semantic search, multi-agent routing, 30+ tool skills, and multi-tier contextual memory.

hero.title: Everything a multi-agent AI assistant needs to work on your behalf
hero.subtitle: From internal knowledge lookup to multi-step workflow automation — see each pillar of J.A.R.V.I.S. in detail.

rag.title: Hybrid RAG Semantic Search
rag.desc: Upload internal documents so the agent can search them with hybrid vector + keyword semantic search, answering with cited sources instead of guessing.
bullets: Upload documents (PDF, text, and more) to build your own knowledge base
Combines vector search with keyword matching for more accurate retrieval
Answers always cite the original source document
Document data is isolated per account (multi-tenant)

multiAgent.title: Multi-Agent Routing
multiAgent.desc: Every request is automatically routed to the best-fit model among DeepSeek, Gemini, and Claude — balancing answer quality against operating cost.
bullets: Automatically picks a model based on request complexity
No need to manually choose or configure a model
Optimizes cost by using cheaper models for simpler tasks
Switches flexibly between models within the same conversation

toolSkills.title: 30+ Tool Skills
toolSkills.desc: A built-in skill library lets the agent execute tasks on its own instead of just answering questions — from reading files and running code to calling internal APIs.
bullets: Reads and analyzes uploaded files and documents
Executes code and manages tasks right within the conversation
Calls internal APIs to fetch or update data
Requires confirmation before performing potentially destructive actions

memory.title: Multi-tier memory
memory.desc: The agent remembers your preferences, facts, and important context across chat sessions, making later conversations smoother instead of having to repeat yourself.
bullets: Stores personal preferences to personalize responses
Remembers facts and information mentioned previously
Recognizes entities (people, places, projects...) referenced repeatedly
Automatically deduplicates, keeping the higher-confidence information

bilingual.title: Bilingual interface & replies
bilingual.desc: The entire interface and the agent's replies fully support Vietnamese and English, automatically following whichever language you've selected.
bullets: Switch languages instantly right from the interface
The agent replies in the conversation's current language
Applied consistently across every page and feature
